source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 11 iulie — «Sfântul Cuvios Leon din Mandra»

attestations.note: The page the calendar links under this name carries the name and nothing else — no life, no troparion, no year — so nothing identifies him with any other Leo.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Ιουλίου — «Όσιος Λέων ο εν τη Μάνδρα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the byname is the folder's own: the Romanian line reads «Sfântul Cuvios Leon din Mandra» and the Greek «Όσιος Λέων ο εν τη Μάνδρα». He is the corpus's only Leo of Mandra, and the Greek notice is as short as the Romanian one. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
